issue.title: Fridge door won't close

intake.title: Fridge door won't close
intake.description: My refrigerator door does not close fully. A milk carton may be in the way. I do not know the model.

step.why: A blocked door allows warm air in. Correcting an obstruction is a simple first check.
step.title: Check whether the door closes fully
step.detail: Move any container that prevents the door closing normally. Look for an obvious gap; do not force the door or remove its parts. Keep perishable food safe while cooling is uncertain.

issue.title: Fridge is warm

intake.title: Fridge is warm
intake.description: My refrigerator is warm but the door closes fully. Food is packed against the visible inside air vents. I do not know the model.

step.why: Blocked interior vents can restrict circulation. Clearing them does not confirm that the appliance is working properly.
step.title: Give the inside vents some space
step.detail: If food is pressed against a visible interior air vent, move it away without removing covers. Keep the door closed afterwards. If cooling remains uncertain, contact service rather than waiting on this app.

source.label: Whirlpool: refrigerator troubleshooting
source.quote: ensure no items are blocking the vents.
